prompt: Create a clean, highly readable architecture infographic for the Luminarr project. Title in Chinese: Luminarr 项目结构总览. Show four private-chat entry channels across the top: Telegram, personal WeChat, Feishu, WeCom. Route them into one shared runtime layer, then into services, then clients and SQLite truth, then external systems. Include these external systems as labeled nodes: TMDB, Prowlarr, Transmission, qBittorrent, Emby, Jellyfin, Plex. Make SQLite visually prominent as the only source of truth. Add a compact workflow strip with these Chinese steps in order: 搜索 -> 下载审批 -> 导入审批 -> metadata 刮削 -> 字幕翻译 -> 刷新. Style must be simple, flat, modern, and editorial. Light background, strong spacing, clear box hierarchy, crisp arrows, readable Chinese labels, restrained blue-green accents. No 3D, no glossy effects, no cyberpunk, no fake dashboard, no watermark.
composition: landscape poster with centered hierarchy and large readable labels
constraints: Chinese-first labels, subtitle translation must be visible in the workflow, no fake features, no buttons, no watermark
